Item.value: This is a blend AcrylnitrilButadienStyrol (ABS) material card. The values are at the low end of the spectrum. If you need a more precise material definition use the more specialised ABS-blend cards.

Property.name: Offset
Property.doc: Set thickness offset of the shell elements

Property.name: Thickness
Property.doc: set thickness of the shell elements

Property.name: SolverPrecision
Property.doc: Precision of solver (a smaller number will quite with an error if this accuracy can't be met)

Property.name: CharacteristicLengthMax
Property.doc: Max mesh element size (0.0 means infinity)

Property.name: ElementDimension
Property.doc: Dimension of mesh elements ('From Shape': according ShapeType of part to mesh)

Property.name: GroupsOfNodes
Property.doc: For each group create not only the elements but the nodes too

Property.name: MeshSizeFromCurvature
Property.doc: Number of elements per 2*pi radians, 0 to deactivate

Property.name: OptimizeNetgen
Property.doc: Optimize tetra elements by use of Netgen

Property.name: Recombine3DAll
Property.doc: Apply recombination algorithm to all volumes

Property.name: RecombineAll
Property.doc: Apply recombination algorithm to all surfaces

Property.name: SecondOrderLinear
Property.doc: Second order nodes are created by linear interpolation

Property.name: MassFlowRate
Property.doc: List of mass flow rate values

Property.name: MaxShear
Property.doc: List of Maximum Shear stress values

Property.name: MohrCoulomb
Property.doc: List of Mohr Coulomb stress values

Property.name: Peeq
Property.doc: List of equivalent plastic strain values

Property.name: vonMises
Property.doc: List of von Mises equivalent stresses

Property.name: AutomaticIncrementation
Property.doc: If False, switch off automatic incrementation via `DIRECT` parameter and ignore minimum and maximum time increments. Analysis may not converge!

Property.name: BeamReducedIntegration
Property.doc: Set to True to use beam elements with reduced integration

Property.name: BucklingFactors
Property.doc: Calculates the lowest buckling modes to the corresponding buckling factors

Property.name: DisplaceMesh
Property.doc: Deform the mesh by the displacement field

Property.name: EigenmodeHighLimit
Property.doc: High frequency limit for eigenmode calculations

Property.name: EigenmodeLowLimit
Property.doc: Low frequency limit for eigenmode calculations

Property.name: EigenmodesCount
Property.doc: Number of modes for frequency calculations

Property.name: ExcludeBendingStiffness
Property.doc: Exclude bending stiffness to replace shells with membranes or beams with trusses

Property.name: IncrementsMaximum
Property.doc: Maximum Number of increments in each CalculiX step. Set to 0 to use CalculiX default value

Property.name: IterationsControlParameterCutb
Property.doc: User defined time incrementation cutbacks control parameter

Property.name: IterationsControlParameterIter
Property.doc: User defined time incrementation iterations control parameter

Property.name: IterationsControlParameterTimeUse
Property.doc: Use the user defined time incrementation control parameter

Property.name: MaterialNonlinearity
Property.doc: If available, use nonlinear material properties

Property.name: OutputFrequency
Property.doc: Set the output frequency in increments

Property.name: PastixMixedPrecision
Property.doc: Mixed precision for the PaStiX matrix solver

Property.name: SplitInputWriter
Property.doc: Split writing of ccx input file

Property.name: ThermoMechSteadyState
Property.doc: Choose between steady state thermo mech or transient thermo mech analysis

Property.name: TimePeriod
Property.doc: Time period of the CalculiX step

Property.name: WorkingDir
Property.doc: Working directory for calculations. Will only be used it is left blank in preferences

Property.doc: Set thickness offset of the shell elements

Property.name: Thickness
Property.doc: set thickness of the shell elements
